_excluded.shanghai/zhujiajiao_0.jpg: photographer watermark burned into the frame
_excluded.beijing/templeofheaven_1.jpg: portrait of an identifiable private individual, not a site photo
_excluded.xian/tangcity_0.jpg: scraped as "Tang Paradise" (Daming Furong Garden) but labelled Tang Dynasty Ever-Bright City; two different Xi'an sites and the itinerary names the latter
_excluded.hangzhou/longjing_0.jpg: a stone teapot ornament, not the tea plantation the label claims
_excluded.chongqing/liziba_0.jpg: labelled "monorail through the building" but no building is in frame
_excluded.xian/foodstreet_1.jpg: close-up of toy birds, reads as nothing
_excluded.beijing/forbiddencity_2.jpg: close-up of a bronze cauldron, reads as nothing
_excluded.beijing/summerpalace_1.jpg: a wall and a pine, reads as nothing
_excluded.beijing/forbiddencitysnow_2.jpg: thin panorama strip, unusable in a grid
_excluded.chongqing/gorges_2.jpg: muddy water and a boat railing, reads as nothing
_excluded.shanghai/bund_2.jpg: on Commons as CC0, but the only author credited there is a pxfuel.com link — a stock aggregator whose licence claims are not reliable enough to print in a customer brochure. Use bund_1, which has a named photographer.
